jobs.description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About Frontier Faculty Frontier™ is a decision operating system. It puts AI to work on the decisions that matter most to large organisations, such as where to invest, how to allocate resources, and when to act. Every enterprise is investing heavily in AI, but few are confident it will improve performance. Too often it goes to what’s easy to automate, disconnected from the decisions that actually move the business. Frontier works backwards from objectives like revenue, margin and risk to the decisions that drive them, then connects the data, models and agents those decisions need into a world model of the business. Teams simulate and optimise options with ADA, our AI decision agent, and every decision is tracked against its outcome so the system keeps learning. Our ambition is to make business decisions as easy to navigate as getting around a city. We don’t believe in AI that thinks for people. jobs.description: About Wayflyer Businesses come to Wayflyer to get the capital they need to grow. When they apply, connect their data or upload documents, every screen, word and transition either builds their trust or loses it. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer with exceptional craft, strong product instincts and a builder mentality to shape how they access and manage capital. You will take financial workflows and information-rich experiences from first idea to shipped product, and make them feel intuitive and trustworthy. As part of our fully remote team of 15 designers across Product, Brand, Motion, and Design. Systems, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, share a common design system, and challenge each other’s work through open critiques, always pushing the quality of our craft forward. How we think about craft Craft is for the customer. Design should improve experiences, not just appearances. Execution matters. From pixels to micro-interactions, nothing should feel accidental. Trust is built through details . Especially when making decisions about their money. Quality is a choice we make every day. It is not a final polish step or a handoff. Speed and quality go together. We ship early, learn from real use and keep improving. You can't write quality into a spec. It comes from people who care and who build. Who Thrives Here You don't wait for perfect requirements. You define the problem first. You balance customer needs, business goals and technical limits. You believe simplifying is one of the hardest and most valuable design skills. You care deeply about craft and know that details matter. You know that trust in financial products is built through hundreds of small interactions. You push back when it matters, for the customer and for quality. You use AI to explore, prototype and improve your work. You thrive in a fast-moving team. What You'll Actually Do Own complex financial problems from discovery to delivery, and turn dense data into clear, scalable experiences.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.
